entries.29c940dde45d8ebb: This division manufactures and sells solar cell modules using solar cell module manufacturing technology, and manufactures, installs and sells film-laminated glass for heat insulation and scattering prevention used in house and building windows. Using machinery manufacturing technology, it also operates a factory automation integrator business, manufactures and sells equipment for semiconductor and liquid crystal applications, designs, builds and sells photovoltaic power generation systems, and undertakes logistics contracting. entries.35c8f7c0c8a876df: Precision lamination is a technology unique to the company's group that bonds optically functional films and other materials of various sizes with micro-level precision, and it is supported by a self-built production line, sensory inspection in which people visually judge quality, and a system of multi-skilled worker training. As panel manufacturers demand higher lamination precision, the company explains that this technology holds an important position in differentiating it from competitors.
